title: JSONMode strictness & legacy-interop compatibility probe
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: validate a tightened JSONMode enforcement profile against legacy client integrations and verify graceful recovery when constrained-decoder fails under streaming/tool-call interleaving. Goal is to detect real-world regressions that would surface for customers using older SDKs or routing through compatibility layers. This probe focuses on three vectors: strict schema enforcement, partial-stream reassembly, and behavior when tool/function-calls appear mid-stream.

Context: recent runtime changes introduced a lower-latency constrained-decoder path that rejects outputs earlier when they deviate from the declared schema. Early lab runs reduced noise but uncovered two classes of customer-visible failures: (1) legacy SDKs (v0.x) that expect permissive fallback strings, and (2) streaming sessions where tool call tokens split the JSON payload and the decoder backtracks incorrectly. This ticket defines an experiment matrix, smoke tests, and remediation runbook for the above scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Define test matrix that covers: model family variants, quantization levels (fp16, int8), streaming vs non-streaming, and SDK compatibility shims.
Automated smoke suite demonstrates >95% successful JSON parse and schema adherence across reshaped streaming packets for baseline workload.

When constrained-decoder detects schema violation, fallback policy triggers a coherent, developer-friendly sentinel payload (per design doc) instead of truncating the stream or returning malformed JSON.
Legacy SDK v0.9 and v1.0 compatibility tests pass: when the client does not support strict JSONMode, behaviour defaults to 'soft-fail' with telemetry and a clear deprecation header.
Operational metrics added to console: jsonmode.failures, decoder.backoffs, streaming.partial_recoveries with alert on spike >3x baseline.
Runbook documented for rolling back to permissive decoding or enabling compatibility shim per-customer.
test_plan: Matrix: combinations of (model small/medium/large), (quantization fp16/int8), (runtime kernel set A/B), (streaming true/false), (tool-call interleaving true/false), (SDK v0.9/v1.0/py-sdk-latest).
Construct canonical schema for a checkout-flow payload (order: items[], shipping{address}, payment{method, token}), plus a deliberately nested optional metadata block to exercise recursion depth.
Create synthetic prompts that cause streaming fragments to split at: (a) object boundaries, (b) inside string values, (c) between tool-call tokens and JSON tokens.
Run baseline non-stream parsing to assert constrained-decoder accepts valid payloads and rejects malformed ones deterministically.

Run streaming sessions with intentional mid-stream tool.call events. Observe decoder state machine: ensure KV cache replay and prefix-safety logic reconstructs the JSON or emits sentinel fallback as designed.
Compatibility shim validation: exercise legacy client header 'X-Redwood-SDK: v0.9' and assert response contains header 'X-JSONMode: permissive' and telemetry tag 'legacy_compat=true'.
Chaos injection: simulate network chunk reordering and small packet loss to measure partial reassembly resilience. Failure thresholds recorded.
Regression gating: add smoke job in CI that runs small subset of matrix nightly; full matrix runs as a pre-merge job for the runtime-1.19 release branch.
Document manual exploratory sessions: run with real customer-like prompts (anonymized) that previously tripped the decoder and capture recordings.
Post-mortem plan if >5% of runs fail on any stable model: collect flight logs, enable verbose decoder tracing, create hotfix branch for decoder state machine.
Close-loop: feed failing prompt-variants to Optimize team for model-quantization suggestions and to Research for decoder heuristics.
Add unit tests for constrained-decoder deterministic random seed that yields identical accept/reject decisions across kernels.
Perform end-to-end test with Console: ensure jsonmode.failures surfaces on per-route dashboard and show example traces linking to flight recorder.
Run targeted customer safety smoke: ensure when 'strict' is enabled for an enterprise account, the fallback payload includes a clear remediation hint and an audit event.
Measure latency impact of stricter enforcement under load; if p95 latency increases >15% revert and iterate on lighter-weight checks.
Document CLI recipe for reproducing failures locally using dev-runtime and streaming proxy.
Add gating to deployment pipeline: when enabling strict-jsonmode by default, require 0.5% or lower regression on customer-facing metrics in canary.
Verify compatibility with function/tool-calling adapters: ensure tool-return schema is treated as nested schema and not as stream-control.
Validate that sentinel fallback is machine-parseable by downstream SDKs to support graceful UX in product clients.
Schedule cross-team review with SDK and Console owners before final ship.
Ensure test artifacts stored in a designated folder and linked in ticket.
Create post-deploy audit that runs a small synthetic load against 10 active canary routes for 72 hours.
If issues observed, run an immediate toggle to 'compatibility-shim' while root cause is investigated.
All tests and runbook steps recorded as reproducible scripts in the runtime repo under tests/jsonmode/.
Document known false positives and add heuristics for suppression where appropriate.
activity: 2025-02-10 Asha Patel: Created ticket outlining problem statement and initial hypothesis after triaging two customer bugs.
2025-02-11 Marco Chen: Added preliminary test matrix and requested assistance from SDK team to reproduce legacy-client headers.
2025-02-12 Lena Morales (SDK): Provided a lightweight shim branch and example repro code for v0.9 behavior (link: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-shim/pull/42).

2025-02-13 Marco Chen: Ran local streaming experiments; observed decoder backtracking loop when tool.call tokens appear immediately after an opening brace. Saved traces to flight-recorder/ENG-128999/2025-02-13.tar.gz.
2025-02-14 Omar Singh (Research): Suggested a conservative repair: temporarily allow one reassembly attempt per stream-chunk and emit a sentinel if second attempt fails. Experiment added to plan.

2025-02-16 Marco Chen: Implemented smoke harness and ran 250 synthetic sessions across model-small/fp16; baseline pass rate 93% with new heuristic. Recorded gaps where nested metadata exceeded depth threshold.
2025-02-18 PM review: Requested metrics capture for p99 latency and an alert threshold for jsonmode.failures. Added to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-20 Marco Chen: Updated ticket with experimental results, artifacts, and proposed rollout plan. Ready for cross-team review on 2025-02-21.
Pending: schedule compatibility retro with Console and Support to align on communication for customers who opt into strict enforcement.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): enable strict-jsonmode on 2 internal routes for 48 hours, monitor jsonmode.failures and p95 latency.
Phase 2 (Customer Opt-in): expose a toggle in Console for enterprise customers to opt-in; capture telemetry and customer feedback.
Phase 3 (Gradual Default): after 72h canary with failure delta <0.5%, gradually enable default strictness for 10% of traffic per region per day.
Rollback: instant rollback via feature-flag to 'compatibility-shim' if failures spike >3x baseline or p95 latency regresses >15%.
Post-rollout: 7-day audit and follow-up patch window for decoder heuristics.
Communication: notify Support/Success with a pre-baked FAQ and sample remediation steps.
SDK: release patch to py-sdk that will surface sentinel payloads as structured errors for better developer UX.
Docs: update Structured Outputs section in API docs and add migration guide for legacy SDKs.
Compliance check: ensure audit logging captures 'jsonmode_enforcement' events for private deployments.
Console: add dashboard card showing routes with highest jsonmode.failures and links to flight-recorders.
metrics_to_capture: streaming.partial_recoveries: count of streams where reassembly succeeded after heuristic
customer-facing-errors: number of API error responses attributable to schema enforcement
sdk_deprecation_warnings: number surfaced to v0.x clients
fallback_payload_rate: percent of responses that return sentinel fallback vs full JSON
canary_error_budget_consumption: track against SLA for canary routes
